about: Target chains (GM - Design, #219 r24 Q2, r47 Q1 and r62): the same cases run through the backend's AgentPresence._target_point and _target_chains (tests/test_agent_cursor_followups.py) and the tab's chainPoint and targetChains (frontend/tests/agentCursorLook.test.ts), so the two can't drift. A target is a point {x, y}, a node box {node: {x, y, width, height}}, which points at its header middle, or a port on one {node, handle, port: {x, y, width, height}} (port bounds relative to the node): the tab draws it on the port, and it counts as its node's header middle for the chain on both sides. zoom, when given, is the view's zoom: the chain is in canvas units at any zoom, so it changes no chain, and the tab's column insert compares in the same canvas units (r62). chains lists each cursor's linked cursors, sorted. traces (GM - Design, #219 r75.3): a (arrived first) is carried by its node (carry: the node's size; path: the node's position frame by frame, the last one the drop) past h, a port cursor (arrived second) at the trace's zoom. The backend side drops at every path point through carry_nodes: a arrives (its chain changes) exactly from index arrivalFrom on (null: never). The tab side drags along the path: slots lists a's slot in h's column (how many of its members are drawn above it) each time it changes, the last one held through the drop and the hold, nothing moving there. The r85 traces (GM - Design, #219 r85 rule b) add zoom 0.25 and 0.1 (onto the tip from above, the left and below, and onto the header) and a left input near the header (port at y 62) at 0.25, 0.5 and 1: the tab's band joins in canvas units at every zoom (the zoom-1 join), so a carry on a port's tip never takes the band slot however far out the view is, and the backend, which has no zoom, agrees.
